positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Lead a team of 8 engineers to build a new AI Agents service from scratch enabling no-code custom Agents in Amazon Quick Suite. Designed a scalable back-end architecture supporting 100K+ internal and 1M+ external users at 30k+ requests/min. Launched with full CI/CD deployments covered by 300+ comprehensive tests.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer II
positions.description:
Developing new chat attachment features and REST APIs for Amazon Q Business.

Defined the testing strategy for an internal SDK written in C++ and Python. Led a team of 3 to implement static code analysis and memory analyzers for both languages, resulting in the discovery of 30 issues.

Designed and implemented a feature that enables containerized customer applications running on AWS Panorama devices to securely leverage hardware acceleration, increasing performance by over 2x.

Developed a feature to configure AWS Panorama device firewall rules, enabling compatibility with complex customer network environments and unblocking $60k in annual recurring revenue.

Identified and drove resolution of release infrastructure inefficiencies, saving $25k/month in EC2 costs.

Proposed Git strategies for release management and drove adoption across 36 code packages and 4 features.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Developed a custom end-to-end integration testing framework for AWS Panorama devices using pytest. Drove team-wide adoption and achieved 95% test case coverage, saving 43 SDE days/year of manual release testing.

Architected a feature to improve system observability by including status information in heartbeat messages defined in Protobuf from processes developed in C++, Python, and Golang.

Designed and implemented a feature enabling runtime camera configuration for AWS Panorama applications.

Onboarded 33 C++ packages to Coverity static code analysis, identifying and fixing 50+ high-priority issues.

Eliminated the need to manually edit generated C++ and Go code using OpenAPI templates.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Built a microservice simulating AWS Panorama device communications to test cloud service behavior. Designed a fault-tolerant REST API, implemented with an AWS back-end using Java and Dagger dependency injection.

Incorporated this new microservice with 10+ existing production cloud service integration and canary tests.

positions.title: Software Intern
positions.description:
Implemented initial adoption of the GoogleTest framework in an open-source library used to interact with all Intrepid Control Systems products. Exposed and fixed 5 existing issues after writing 13 test cases.

Delivered 4 sample applications in C, C++, C#, and Java using SWIG to generate cross-language wrappers.

positions.title: Software Team Captain
positions.description:
Implemented advanced control loops, including PID & motion profiling.
Led development of Java robot code and oversaw recruitment of new members.
Created and established organized Git workflow processes for 10+ programmers.
Ensured functionality of essential systems in a 12,000+ line codebase with JUnit testing.

company.name: Palo Alto High School Robotics Team

positions.title: Research Intern
positions.description: Set up a simulation to research mobile ad-hoc network communication protocols using Java.

positions.title: Trainee
positions.description:
Attended a week-long OSGi training session along with 10 other industry professionals.
Learned techniques for modular program deployment and dependency management.

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description:
Developed decision-making & control code for a fully autonomous satellite in C++.
Won the 2015 Virtual World Championship run aboard the ISS.

volunteerExperiences.description: Led a team of ~10 students to create curriculum and teach Python to 40+ middle school students.
